event_chain.summary: Publishing error: private repo made public

summary: A GitHub repository named 'Private-CISA' belonging to the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency was publicly accessible from November 13, 2025, exposing 844MB of sensitive data including plain-text passwords, authentication tokens and other secrets for government systems. GitGuardian researcher Guillaume Valadon found it on May 14, 2026 after automated monitoring flagged it; CISA's postmortem attributes the exposure to a contractor and the repo was taken down within about 26 hours of notification.
